items.title: Turing publishes 'Securing Resilience for the Age of AI' agenda; CEO warns of cascading disruption
items.summary_en: The Turing Institute published a research and innovation agenda called 'Securing Resilience for the Age of AI', which proposes five Transformational Resilience Goals. CEO George Williamson warned that the UK faces growing risks of cascading disruption and needs new AI capabilities.
items.notes: Direct fetch of turing.ac.uk failed (host not in session's allowed network domains). Details come from a web-search listing of the institute's own pages. The article title matches the CEO-warning story, but the link between this URL and the 17 Nov date was not verified. Press release, not peer-reviewed. Date is just before the nominal window start.

items.title: Turing policy roadmap on reducing UK exposure to AI disruption
items.summary_en: According to the search listing, the Institute published a policy roadmap saying the UK will be increasingly exposed to AI disruption unless it takes practical steps. The listing gave no further detail.

items.notes: Only the news index URL is cited because the specific article URL was not confirmed. Not read directly. The Orchestrator should re-check once turing.ac.uk is reachable. It may be the same story as the 17 Nov item, or a closely related one.

items.title: Adrian Belton appointed Chair of the Turing's Board of Trustees
items.summary_en: The Institute announced that Adrian Belton has been appointed as the new Chair of its Board of Trustees.

coverage_note: Limited coverage. WebFetch could not reach www.turing.ac.uk (host not in the session's allowed network domains; it needs to be allowed for a direct read), so everything comes from one web-search snippet of the institute's own listings. The newest item found is dated 18 Nov 2026 and nothing later was seen. The search results also listed two other Turing pages, a 'practical agenda to tackle frontier AI risks' and a 'new science and innovation programme' announcement. Their publication dates could not be confirmed, so they are not included as items. Events in the listing (Women in AI Security, 3 Nov; 'From idea to investment', 11 Nov) were omitted because they are events rather than research outputs. No linked preprints or talk recordings were checked. All items need verification against the primary pages before use.
